--CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW real_assets_portfolio_listed AS
WITH 
quarter_end AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter',  CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1' DAY AS quarter_end_date
),
quarter_start AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '3' MONTH AS quarter_start_date
),
latest_fiscal_quarter AS (
    SELECT CONCAT(
             'F', 
             SUBSTR(CAST(YEAR(reporting_date) as VARCHAR), 3, 2), 
             ' Q', 
             CAST(QUARTER(reporting_date) as VARCHAR)
           ) AS reporting_period
      FROM (
            SELECT CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM quarter_end_date) BETWEEN 4 AND 12 
                        THEN DATE_ADD('month', -3, DATE_ADD('year', 1, quarter_end_date))
                        ELSE DATE_ADD('month', 9, quarter_end_date)
                   END AS reporting_date
              FROM quarter_end
           )
),
listed_real_estate_model_portfolios AS (
     SELECT CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)               AS business_date,
            mp.model_portfolio_id,
            mp.model_portfolio_name,
            mp.int_ext_managed_and_managed_accounts_name,
            CASE mp.regional_classification_name
                 WHEN 'Emerging Markets' 
                 THEN 'Emerging'
                 ELSE 'Developed'
            END                                           AS developed_or_emerging
       FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten pif
 INNER JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio mp
         ON pif.model_portfolio                    = mp.model_portfolio_id
      WHERE pif.model_portfolio_name        NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructure                = 'CPPIB_F24'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel2          = 'Real Assets'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel3          = 'Real Estate'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel4          = 'Listed Real Estate'
        AND CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)        = CAST(mp.business_date AS DATE)
),
listed_infrastrucure_model_portfolios AS (
     SELECT CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)               AS business_date,
            mp.model_portfolio_id,
            mp.model_portfolio_name,
            mp.int_ext_managed_and_managed_accounts_name,
            CASE mp.regional_classification_name
                 WHEN 'Emerging Markets' 
                 THEN 'Emerging'
                 ELSE 'Developed'
            END                                           AS developed_or_emerging
       FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten pif
 INNER JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio mp
         ON pif.model_portfolio                    = mp.model_portfolio_id
      WHERE pif.model_portfolio_name        NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructure                = 'CPPIB_F24'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel2          = 'Real Assets'

--CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW real_assets_portfolio_listed AS
WITH 
quarter_end AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter',  CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1' DAY AS quarter_end_date
),
quarter_start AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '3' MONTH AS quarter_start_date
),
latest_fiscal_quarter AS (
    SELECT CONCAT(
             'F', 
             SUBSTR(CAST(YEAR(reporting_date) as VARCHAR), 3, 2), 
             ' Q', 
             CAST(QUARTER(reporting_date) as VARCHAR)
           ) AS reporting_period
      FROM (
            SELECT CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM quarter_end_date) BETWEEN 4 AND 12 
                        THEN DATE_ADD('month', -3, DATE_ADD('year', 1, quarter_end_date))
                        ELSE DATE_ADD('month', 9, quarter_end_date)
                   END AS reporting_date
              FROM quarter_end
           )
),
listed_infrastrucure_model_portfolios AS (
     SELECT CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)               AS business_date,
            mp.model_portfolio_id,
            mp.model_portfolio_name,
            mp.int_ext_managed_and_managed_accounts_name,
            CASE mp.regional_classification_name
                 WHEN 'Emerging Markets' 
                 THEN 'Emerging'
                 ELSE 'Developed'
            END                                           AS developed_or_emerging
       FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten pif
 INNER JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio mp
         ON pif.model_portfolio                    = mp.model_portfolio_id
      WHERE pif.model_portfolio_name        NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructure                = 'CPPIB_F24'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel2          = 'Real Assets'
        AND (
              (     pif.InvestmentStructureLevel3          = 'Infrastructure'
                AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel4         IN ('Dev Mkts - Infrastructure', 'Emerging Mkts - Infrastructure')
                AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel5         IN ('Listed Infrastructure - DM', 'Listed Infrastructure - EM')
                AND pif.model_portfolio NOT IN ('')
              )
              OR pif.model_portfolio IN ('MIN1000104')
        )
        AND CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)        = CAST(mp.business_date AS DATE)
),
listed_real_estate_model_portfolios AS (
     SELECT CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)               AS business_date,
            mp.model_portfolio_id,
            mp.model_portfolio_name,
            mp.int_ext_managed_and_managed_accounts_name,
            CASE mp.regional_classification_name
                 WHEN 'Emerging Markets' 
                 THEN 'Emerging'
                 ELSE 'Developed'
            END                                           AS developed_or_emerging
       FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten pif
 INNER JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio mp
         ON pif.model_portfolio                    = mp.model_portfolio_id
      WHERE pif.model_portfolio_name        NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructure                = 'CPPIB_F24'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel2          = 'Real Assets'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel3          = 'Real Estate'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel4          = 'Listed Real Estate'
        AND CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)        = CAST(mp.business_date AS DATE)
),
listed_sustainable_energies_model_portfolios AS (
     SELECT CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)               AS business_date,
            mp.model_portfolio_id,
            mp.model_portfolio_name,
            mp.int_ext_managed_and_managed_accounts_name,
            CASE mp.regional_classification_name
                 WHEN 'Emerging Markets' 
                 THEN 'Emerging'
                 ELSE 'Developed'
            END                                           AS developed_or_emerging
       FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten pif
 INNER JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio mp
         ON pif.model_portfolio                    = mp.model_portfolio_id
      WHERE pif.model_portfolio_name      NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructure                = 'CPPIB_F24'    
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel2          = 'Real Assets'
        AND (
              (     pif.InvestmentStructureLevel3     = 'Sustainable Energy Group'
                AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel4     IN ('Power and Renewables Group')
                AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel5     IN ('Power Generation')
                AND pif.investmentstructurelevel6     IN ('DM - Power Generation', 'EM - Power Generation')
                AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel7     IN ('Listed DM', 'Listed EM')
                AND pif.model_portfolio           NOT IN ('')
              )
              OR pif.model_portfolio IN ('MPRSBE0', 'MPR1000279', 'MPR1000328', 'MPR1000200', 'MPAR100041')
        )
        AND CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)        = CAST(mp.business_date AS DATE)
),
listed_real_assets_model_portfolios AS (
     SELECT * 
       FROM listed_infrastrucure_model_portfolios
  UNION ALL
     SELECT * 
       FROM listed_real_estate_model_portfolios
   UNION ALL
     SELECT * 
       FROM listed_sustainable_energies_model_portfolios
),
latest_abor_transactions AS (
     SELECT abor_transaction_number,
            MAX(business_date)       AS latest_business_date
       FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions
      WHERE CAST(period_closure_date AS DATE) <= (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
        AND CAST(period_closure_date AS DATE) >= (SELECT quarter_start_date FROM quarter_start)
        AND transaction_cancellation_flag  = 'Active'
        AND business_transaction_code     != 'BalBook' -- come back to this
   GROUP BY abor_transaction_number
),
latest_lra_transactions AS (
     SELECT t.created_date,
            t.elementary_transaction_code,
            t.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency,
            t.interest_dividend_capital_event_portfolio_currency,
            t.interest_dividend_capital_event_quotation_currency,
            t.counterparty_id,
            t.payment_amount_portfolio_currency,
            t.payment_amount_quotation_currency,
            t.current_value_portfolio_currency,
            t.current_value_quotation_currency,
            t.nominal,
            t.payment_date,
            t.period_closure_agreement_date,
            t.period_closure_date,
            t.period_closure_payment_date,
            t.price,
            t.quotation_currency,
            t.abor_security_id
       FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions t
 INNER JOIN listed_real_assets_model_portfolios mp
         ON t.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio_id
 INNER JOIN latest_abor_transactions at
         ON t.abor_transaction_number = at.abor_transaction_number
        AND t.business_date           = at.latest_business_date
      WHERE t.transaction_cancellation_flag     = 'Active'
        AND t.business_transaction_code        != 'BalBook'
        AND CAST(t.period_closure_date AS DATE) <= (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
        AND CAST(t.period_closure_date AS DATE) >= (SELECT quarter_start_date FROM quarter_start)
),
latest_lra_total_buys_and_sells AS(
     SELECT abor_security_id,
            SUM(
              CASE WHEN elementary_transaction_code IN ('CABuy', 'BuyInternal', 'Buy') 
                   THEN payment_amount_portfolio_currency 
                   ELSE 0 
              END
            ) AS total_buy_portfolio_currency_cad, -- changed from just buy to 'CABuy', 'BuyInternal', 'Buy'
            SUM(
              CASE WHEN elementary_transaction_code IN ('CASell', 'SellInternal', 'Sell')
                   THEN current_value_portfolio_currency 
                   ELSE 0 
              END
            ) AS total_sell_portfolio_currency_cad  -- changed from just sell to ('CASell', 'SellInternal', 'Sell')
       FROM latest_lra_transactions
   GROUP BY abor_security_id
),
latest_holdings AS (
     SELECT CAST(h.business_date AS DATE)               AS business_date,
            int_ext_managed_and_managed_accounts_name,
            asec.cppib_sector_classification_name_3,
            asec.cppib_sector_classification_name_4,
            developed_or_emerging,
            h.abor_security_id,
            abor_security_name,
            model_portfolio_name,
            abor_country_of_exposure_name,
            balance_cost_value_portfolio_currency,
            dirty_value_total_portfolio_currency,
            exposure_portfolio_currency,
            tbs.total_buy_portfolio_currency_cad        AS gross_invested_equity_historical,
            tbs.total_sell_portfolio_currency_cad       AS permanent_roc_historical,
            quotation_currency_code
       FROM holdings.scd_holdings_main h
 INNER JOIN listed_real_assets_model_portfolios mp
         ON h.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio_id
  FULL JOIN latest_lra_total_buys_and_sells tbs
         ON h.abor_security_id = tbs.abor_security_id
  LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications asec
         ON h.cppib_sec_id = CAST(asec.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR)
        AND CAST(h.business_date AS DATE) = asec.business_date
      WHERE CAST(h.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
        AND asec.cppib_sector_classification_name_4 NOT LIKE '%Discontinued%'
)
SELECT * FROM latest_holdings h ORDER BY h.abor_security_id ASC

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 05
		AND hour between 10 and 11
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-05 10:33:00'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

/* cppi::cb5bf52864f48a465b0ebbf28ed9f9161354f0649890e8ed602e9f135528d005 */
-- Query # 23 of 26 to lookup security by ticker/exchange.
    WITH latest_business_date AS (
        SELECT MAX( business_date ) business_date
        FROM asset.asset_security_identifiers i
        WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_equity e WHERE i.business_date = e.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_warrants w WHERE i.business_date = w.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications c WHERE i.business_date = c.business_date )
            )
    SELECT
        -- Some security identifiers are not associated with any sector information.
        -- If two securites have the same sedol, the security with lower Bloomberg security ID 
        -- (and lower cppib security id) is often associated with more populated fields
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY i.sedol ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_sedol,
        ROW_NUMBER() 
            OVER ( PARTITION BY i.ticker, COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) 
            ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_ticker_and_exchange,
        i.cppib_sec_id,
        i.bloomberg_security_id,
        i.sec_typ_lvl1_nm,
        i.sec_typ_lvl2_nm,
        i.sedol,
        i.isin,
        i.ticker,
        COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) equity_exchange_code,
        c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1,
        COALESCE( e.country_code, w.country_code ) country_code,
        c.cppib_country_of_exposure_code cppib_country_of_exposure_code,
        COALESCE( e.currency_code, w.currency_code ) currency_code,
        COALESCE( e.underlying_instrument_currency_code , w.underlying_instrument_currency_code ) underlying_instrument_currency_code,
        -- Capitalize first letter followed by lower case letters to follow HERBI's instrument type letter casing convention
        COALESCE( e.type, w.type ) instrument_type,
        COALESCE( e.risk_country_code, w.risk_country_code ) risk_country_code
    FROM latest_business_date b
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers i 
        ON b.business_date = i.business_date
        AND sec_typ_lvl1_nm != 'Undefined' 
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_equity e ON b.business_date = e.business_date AND i.cppib_sec_id = e.cppib_sec_id 
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_warrants w ON b.business_date = w.business_date AND i.cppib_sec_id = w.cppib_sec_id

-- Query # 23 of 26 to lookup security by ticker/exchange.
    WITH latest_business_date AS (
        SELECT MAX( business_date ) business_date
        FROM asset.asset_security_identifiers i
        WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_equity e WHERE i.business_date = e.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_warrants w WHERE i.business_date = w.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications c WHERE i.business_date = c.business_date )
            )
    SELECT
        -- Some security identifiers are not associated with any sector information.
        -- If two securites have the same sedol, the security with lower Bloomberg security ID 
        -- (and lower cppib security id) is often associated with more populated fields
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY i.sedol ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_sedol,
        ROW_NUMBER() 
            OVER ( PARTITION BY i.ticker, COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) 
            ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_ticker_and_exchange,
        i.cppib_sec_id,
        i.bloomberg_security_id,
        i.sec_typ_lvl1_nm,
        i.sec_typ_lvl2_nm,
        i.sedol,
        i.isin,
        i.ticker,
        COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) equity_exchange_code,
        c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1,
        COALESCE( e.country_code, w.country_code ) country_code,
        c.cppib_country_of_exposure_code cppib_country_of_exposure_code,
        COALESCE( e.currency_code, w.currency_code ) currency_code,
        COALESCE( e.underlying_instrument_currency_code , w.underlying_instrument_currency_code ) underlying_instrument_currency_code,
        -- Capitalize first letter followed by lower case letters to follow HERBI's instrument type letter casing convention
        COALESCE( e.type, w.type ) instrument_type,
        COALESCE( e.risk_country_code, w.risk_country_code ) risk_country_code
    FROM latest_business_date b
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers i 
        ON b.business_date = i.business_date
        AND sec_typ_lvl1_nm != 'Undefined' 
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_equity e ON b.business_date = e.business_date AND i.cppib_sec_id = e.cppib_sec_id 
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_warrants w ON b.business_date = w.business_date AND i.cppib_sec_id = w.cppib_sec_id
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications c ON b.business_date = c.business_date AND i.cppib_sec_id = c.cppib_sec_id

-- Query # 23 of 26 to lookup security by ticker/exchange.
    WITH latest_business_date AS (
        SELECT MAX( business_date ) business_date
        FROM asset.asset_security_identifiers i
        WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_equity e WHERE i.business_date = e.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_warrants w WHERE i.business_date = w.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications c WHERE i.business_date = c.business_date )
            )
    SELECT
        -- Some security identifiers are not associated with any sector information.
        -- If two securites have the same sedol, the security with lower Bloomberg security ID 
        -- (and lower cppib security id) is often associated with more populated fields
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY i.sedol ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_sedol,
        ROW_NUMBER() 
            OVER ( PARTITION BY i.ticker, COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) 
            ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_ticker_and_exchange,
        i.cppib_sec_id,
        i.bloomberg_security_id,
        i.sec_typ_lvl1_nm,
        i.sec_typ_lvl2_nm,
        i.sedol,
        i.isin,
        i.ticker,
        COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) equity_exchange_code,
        c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1,
        COALESCE( e.country_code, w.country_code ) country_code,
        c.cppib_country_of_exposure_code cppib_country_of_exposure_code,
        COALESCE( e.currency_code, w.currency_code ) currency_code,
        COALESCE( e.underlying_instrument_currency_code , w.underlying_instrument_currency_code ) underlying_instrument_currency_code,
        -- Capitalize first letter followed by lower case letters to follow HERBI's instrument type letter casing convention
        COALESCE( e.type, w.type ) instrument_type,
        COALESCE( e.risk_country_code, w.risk_country_code ) risk_country_code
    FROM latest_business_date b
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers i 
        ON b.business_date = i.business_date
        AND sec_typ_lvl1_nm != 'Undefined' 
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_equity e ON b.business_date = e.business_date AND i.cppib_sec_id = e.cppib_sec_id

-- Query # 23 of 26 to lookup security by ticker/exchange.
    WITH latest_business_date AS (
        SELECT MAX( business_date ) business_date
        FROM asset.asset_security_identifiers i
        WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_equity e WHERE i.business_date = e.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_warrants w WHERE i.business_date = w.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications c WHERE i.business_date = c.business_date )
            )
    SELECT
        -- Some security identifiers are not associated with any sector information.
        -- If two securites have the same sedol, the security with lower Bloomberg security ID 
        -- (and lower cppib security id) is often associated with more populated fields
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY i.sedol ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_sedol,
        ROW_NUMBER() 
            OVER ( PARTITION BY i.ticker, COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) 
            ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_ticker_and_exchange,
        i.cppib_sec_id,
        i.bloomberg_security_id,
        i.sec_typ_lvl1_nm,
        i.sec_typ_lvl2_nm,
        i.sedol,
        i.isin,
        i.ticker,
        COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) equity_exchange_code,

/* cppi::e225496a4bd33cf1ac655c2d6d98fa8134c8a61b2ad86615f3bd1caa60a25eca */
WITH RankedSecurities AS (
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY abor_security_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
    FROM reference.scd_securities
    WHERE business_date = '2025-06-04'
)

SELECT a.*, b.*, f.currency_name, g.unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
FROM (
    SELECT
        NULL AS id_enterprise_holding,
        h.portfolio_id AS id_portfolio,
        h.model_portfolio_id AS id_model_portfolio,
        CAST(h.abor_security_id AS VARCHAR) AS id_instrument_new,
        h.scd_holding_key_id AS id_source_holding,
        sec.abor_security_group_id AS instrument_subgroup_code,
        h.security_group_name AS instrument_subgroup_name,
        sec.abor_security_type_id AS instrument_type_code,
        h.abor_security_type_name AS instrument_type_name,
        h.abor_security_name AS instrument_name_source,
        h.clean_value_quotation_currency AS current_nominal,
        h.clean_value_portfolio_currency AS current_nominal_pc,
        h.clean_value_quotation_currency AS clean_market_value,
        h.balance_cost_value_quotation_currency AS cost_value,
        h.balance_book_value_quotation_currency AS book_value,
        h.quotation_currency_code AS quoted_currency_code,
        h.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency AS fx_rate_quoted_in_cad,
        h.clean_value_portfolio_currency AS clean_market_value_pc,
        h.accrued_interest_portfolio_currency AS abacus_accrued_interest_pc,
        h.accrued_interest_quotation_currency AS abacus_accrued_interest_qc,
        h.quotation_currency_code AS current_notional_currency,
        h.quotation_currency_code AS market_value_currency,
        h.balance_cost_value_portfolio_currency AS cost_value_pc,
        h.accrued_interest_quotation_currency AS current_accrued_amount,
        h.accrued_interest_portfolio_currency AS current_accrued_amount_pc,
        CAST(p.id_bb_company_code AS VARCHAR) AS id_counterparty_source_new
    FROM holdings.scd_holdings_main h
    LEFT JOIN RankedSecurities sec
        ON h.scd_security_id = sec.scd_security_key_id
    LEFT JOIN reference.scd_party_issuer p
        ON sec.abor_issuer_id = p.party_id
        AND h.business_date = p.business_date
    WHERE h.business_date = '2025-06-04'
      AND sec.rn = 1
      AND (sec.abor_security_group_id, sec.abor_security_type_id) IN (
            ('CALL COLL', 'PAY COLL'),
            ('CALL COLL', 'SBL COLL'),
            ('CALL EPM', 'CALL EPM'),
            ('CALLM FS', 'CALLM ARS'),
            ('CALLM FS', 'CALLM FX'),
            ('CALLM FS', 'CALLM SYN')
        )
) AS a
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        CAST(cppib_party_id AS VARCHAR) AS cppib_party_id,
        party_name,
        CAST(bloomberg_company_id AS VARCHAR) AS bloomberg_company_id,
        domicile_country_code,
        incorp_country_code
    FROM party.party
    WHERE business_date = DATE '2025-06-04'
) AS b
    ON a.id_counterparty_source_new = b.bloomberg_company_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        currency_code,
        currency_name
    FROM reference.reference_currency_codes
    WHERE business_date = DATE '2025-06-04'
) AS f
    ON a.quoted_currency_code = f.currency_code
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        id_model_portfolio,
        unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
    FROM finance_accounting.model_portfolios
    WHERE business_date = DATE '2025-06-04'
) AS g
    ON a.id_model_portfolio = g.id_model_portfolio

WITH analytic_pv AS
    (select sd.business_date, analytic_value
     from radar_reporting_prod
    .fact_analytic_sd sd
    join radar_reporting_prod.dim_hierarchy_node dh
on sd.dim_hierarchy_node_id = dh.dim_hierarchy_node_id and dh.node_level=2 and dh.node_name ='BCPP' and sd.business_date = dh.business_date

where analytic_type = 'PV'
  and portfolio_type = 'TOTAL_FUND_BY_ACCOUNT'
  and sd.business_date = '2025-06-04'
    )
select ule.party_name,
       ule.gics_sector,
       sum(f.bcpp_credit_exposure)                                 as credit_exposure,
       pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * ule.bcpp_single_name_board_limit as single_name_limit,
       case
           when ule.bcpp_single_name_board_limit > 0 then round(sum(f.bcpp_credit_exposure) /
                                                                (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * ule.bcpp_single_name_board_limit) *
                                                                100, 1)
           else 0 end as usage,
    CASE
        WHEN sum(f.bcpp_credit_exposure) / (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * ule.bcpp_single_name_board_limit) BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.949999999
            THEN 'Yellow Alert'
        WHEN sum(f.bcpp_credit_exposure) / (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * ule.bcpp_single_name_board_limit) BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.999999999
            THEN 'Orange Alert'
        WHEN sum(f.bcpp_credit_exposure) >= (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * ule.bcpp_single_name_board_limit)
            THEN 'Breach'
        ELSE 'OK'
END
AS status

from radar_reporting_prod.fact_cr_exposure f
         join radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity le on f.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = le.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id and f.business_date = le.business_date

         left join analytic_pv pv on f.business_date = pv.business_date

group by ule.party_name, ule.gics_sector, ule.bcpp_single_name_board_limit, pv.analytic_value

		, mhl.pool_name_unified as pool_name
		, mhl.security_name
		, mhl.total_market_value_pc

		, unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name_unified in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name_unified like '%bCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end bcpp_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name_unified in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name_unified like '%aCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc

		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_name

		, mhl.country_of_exposure_name

				when pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Core Pool' ) then 'Core'
				when pool_name in ( 'Supplementary', 'Supplementary Pool' ) then 'Supplementary'
				else pool_name
			  end pool_name_unified
		from 
			holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough

	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join

					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )

			  business_date

				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' then 'Core'
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 'Supplementary'

			, lt_agg.external_reporting_country
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_assetmix
			, lt_agg.business_date_string
			, lt_agg.year_month
			, lt_agg.is_month_end
			, lt_agg.is_fiscalyear_end
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_currency
			--, lt_agg.total_market_value_pc as total_market_value_pc_orig
			, lt_agg_unpivot.total_market_value_pc
		from (
			select
				  business_date
				--, fiscal_date
				, pool_name

				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, external_reporting_assetmix
				, business_date_string
				, year_month
				, is_month_end
				, is_fiscalyear_end
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
				, sum( total_market_value_pc ) as total_market_value_pc
				, sum( bcpp_total_market_value_pc ) as bcpp_total_market_value_pc
				, sum( acpp_total_market_value_pc ) as acpp_total_market_value_pc
			from
				lt_final
			group by 
				  business_date
				--, fiscal_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, external_reporting_assetmix
				, business_date_string
				, year_month
				, is_month_end
				, is_fiscalyear_end
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
		) lt_agg

SELECT *
        FROM (
		    SELECT
		        currencyCode,
			    date,
			    MAX(currencyToUsdRate) OVER (
				    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
				    grouped_usd,
				    data_diff
			    ) as currencyToUsdRate,
                MAX(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
                    grouped_cad,
                    data_diff
                ) as currencyToCadRate
			FROM (
				SELECT date,
					currencyCode,
					currencyToCadRate,
					currencyToUsdRate,
					COUNT(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as grouped_cad,
					COUNT(currencyToUsdRate) OVER (
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as grouped_usd,
					date - LAG(date, 3) OVER(
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as data_diff
				FROM (
						SELECT erc.data_date AS date,
								erc.currency AS currencyCode,
								erc.exchange_rate AS currencyToCadRate,
								erd.exchange_rate AS currencyToUsdRate,
								erc.is_exchange_holiday_flag as holiday_flag
						FROM cppib_market_exchange_rate_cad erc
								LEFT JOIN cppib_market_exchange_rate erd
								ON erc.data_date = erd.data_date
								AND erc.vendor = erd.vendor
								AND erc.currency = erd.currency
							WHERE ((erc.vendor = 'wm' AND erc.currency != 'CLF')
							        OR (erc.vendor = 'tokyo' AND erc.currency = 'CLF'))
								AND erc.currency IN ('USD','EUR','JPY','CHF','AUD','CNY','HKD','NZD','SEK','KRW','SGD','NOK','MXN','INR','DKK','CLF','IDR','CLP','BRL','CAD','MYR','COP','GBP','ARS','RON','RUB','PHP','ILS','PLN','PEN','LTL','LVL','SIT','SAR','ZAR','QAR','CZK','TWD','THB','PKR','TRY','ISK','KWD','AED','JOD','NGN','EGP','HUF','MAD','PGK','MOP','VES','VEF','LKR','BGN','VND','BMD','XOF','BDT','ZMW','KES','HRK','MWK','GHS','MUR','JMD','RSD','TND','KZT','UAH','TTD','OMR','TZS','BWP','UGX','BHD','ZWL','IRR','VEB','ZWG')
								AND erc.data_date BETWEEN to_date('2008-01-01', 'yyyy-mm-dd')
								AND to_date('2025-06-05', 'yyyy-mm-dd')
								AND (erd.exchange_rate is not NULL OR erc.is_exchange_holiday_flag = 1)
						)
					)
			    )
        WHERE currencyToUsdRate is not NULL
        OR currencyToCadRate is not Null
        ORDER BY date

/* cppi::c7cdb65f0546fb68769932c46ec2655278bb1529ee343c8750e9958b2f523e53 */
SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 05
		AND hour between 17 and 18
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-05 17:33:37'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

SELECT *
        FROM (
		    SELECT
		        currencyCode,
			    date,
			    MAX(currencyToUsdRate) OVER (
				    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
				    grouped_usd,
				    data_diff
			    ) as currencyToUsdRate,
                MAX(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
                    grouped_cad,
                    data_diff
                ) as currencyToCadRate
			FROM (
				SELECT date,
					currencyCode,
					currencyToCadRate,
					currencyToUsdRate,
					COUNT(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date

					COUNT(currencyToUsdRate) OVER (

								erc.is_exchange_holiday_flag as holiday_flag

	select business_date,
		dim_hierarchy_node_id,
		node_level,
		(
			case
				when node_level = 1 then 'CPPIB-ALL'
				when node_level = 2 then 'DEPARTMENT'
				when node_level = 3 then 'STRATEGY'
				when node_level = 4 then 'PROGRAM'
				when node_level = 5 then 'SUB-PROGRAM'
				when node_level = 6 then 'MODEL_PORTFOLIO' else 'UNKNOWN'
			end
		) as hierarchy_level,
		'RISK' as hierarchy_type,
		node_name,
		'' as account,
		'' as pool,
		parent_node_id,
		investment_dept,
		investment_strat,
		program,
		sub_program,
		model_portfolio
	from radar_reporting_prod.mv_dim_hierarchy_node_risk
	where business_date = '2025-06-04'
),
classification_secno as 
	(select inst_id, industry_sector_name 
		from asset.asset_instrument_classifications_latest class 
		join radar_reporting_prod.dim_inst i on i.security_number = class.id_holding_decomposition and i.business_date = cast(class.business_date as varchar) 
		where i.business_date = '2025-06-04' and class.holding_decomposition_id_type_code = 'SECURITY_NO'
		union all 
		select inst_id, industry_sector_name 
		from asset.asset_instrument_classifications_latest class 
		join radar_reporting_prod.dim_inst i on i.cppib_security_id = class.id_holding_decomposition and i.business_date = cast(class.business_date as varchar) 
		where i.business_date = '2025-06-04' and class.holding_decomposition_id_type_code = 'CPPIBSEC_ID'
	)
select 
	(
		case
			when dpi.portfolio_type in ('IP', 'CASH_FOR_BENEFIT', 'ACPP_CFB') then dpi.pos_source_system_key
			when dpi.portfolio_type = 'INDEX_LOOKTHROUGH' then replace(dpi.pos_source_system_key, 'CPPSECID')
			when dpi.portfolio_type = 'LOOKTHROUGH' and position('OFFSET' in dpi.pos_source_system_key) > 0 then dpi.pos_source_system_key
			else concat(substr(dpi.pos_source_system_key, 1, position('_' in dpi.pos_source_system_key)-1), '_', dpi.pos_short_desc)
		end 
	) as "position_key",
	currency.iso_currency_code "cs01_currency",
	curve.curve_value "cs01_curve",
	curve_type.curve_type_value "cs01_curve_type",
	cs01.data_source "cs01_data_source",
	term.term_value "cs01_tenor",
	coalesce((1 / fx.mid_val), 1) * cs01.final_value "cs01_cad_value",
	cs01.final_value,	
	cs01.initial_value,
	cs01.override_source,
	cs01.override_value,
	cs01.portfolio_type,
	cs01.scaling_type,
	dpi.maturity_date,
	dpi.pos_short_desc as "position_description",
	rh.model_portfolio as "scd_model_portfolio",
	rh.investment_dept,
	rh.investment_strat as "investment_strategy",
	rh.program as "investment_program",
	rh.sub_program as "investment_sub_program",
	dpi.cppib_product_type as "product_type",
	dpi.security_group_name as "product_group",
	(
		case 
			when i_rle.party_name is not null then i_rle.party_name
			when l1_rle.party_name is not null then l1_rle.party_name
			when mi_rle.party_name is not null then mi_rle.party_name
			else null
		end
	) as issuer_party_name,
	(
		case 
			when i_rle.gics_sector is not null then i_rle.gics_sector
			when l1_rle.gics_sector is not null then l1_rle.gics_sector 
			when cl.industry_sector_name is not null then cl.industry_sector_name
			when mi_rle.gics_sector is not null then mi_rle.gics_sector
			else null
		end
	) as issuer_gics_sector,
	cpr.rating_value as "issuer_final_rating",
	csr.rating_value as "inst_final_rating",
	(
		case 
			when dpi.isin is not null then dpi.isin 
			when inst1.isin is not null then inst1.isin
			else inst2.isin
		end
	) as isin,
	(
		case 
			when dpi.sedol is not null then dpi.sedol 
			when inst1.sedol is not null then inst1.sedol
			else inst2.sedol
		end
	) as sedol,
	(
		case 
			when dpi.cusip is not null then dpi.cusip 
			when inst1.cusip is not null then inst1.cusip
			else inst2.cusip
		end
	) as cusip,
	(
		case 
			when i_rle.secm_exposure_country is not null then i_rle.secm_exposure_country
			when l1_rle.secm_exposure_country is not null then l1_rle.secm_exposure_country 
			when mi_rle.secm_exposure_country is not null then mi_rle.secm_exposure_country
			else null
		end
	) as issuer_country_of_exposure

	join radar_reporting_prod.dim_calc_currency currency ON cs01.dim_calc_currency_id = currency.dim_calc_currency_id
	and cs01.business_date = currency.business_date
	join radar_reporting_prod.dim_calc_term term ON cs01.dim_calc_term_id = term.dim_calc_term_id
	and term.calc_dim_type = 'TERM'
	and cs01.business_date = term.business_date
	join radar_reporting_prod.dim_calc_curve curve ON cs01.dim_calc_curve_id = curve.dim_calc_curve_id
	and curve.calc_dim_type = 'CURVE'
	and cs01.business_date = curve.business_date
	join radar_reporting_prod.dim_calc_curve_type curve_type ON cs01.dim_calc_curve_type_id = curve_type.dim_calc_curve_type_id
	and curve_type.calc_dim_type = 'CURVE_TYPE'
	and cs01.business_date = curve_type.business_date

	(
		case 
			when i_rle.secm_exposure_country is not null then i_rle.secm_exposure_country
			when l1_rle.secm_exposure_country is not null then l1_rle.secm_exposure_country 
			when mi_rle.secm_exposure_country is not null then mi_rle.secm_exposure_country
			else null
		end
	) as issuer_country_of_exposure
from radar_reporting_prod.fact_pos_calc_md cs01
	join radar_reporting_prod.dim_calc_currency currency ON cs01.dim_calc_currency_id = currency.dim_calc_currency_id
	and cs01.business_date = currency.business_date
	join radar_reporting_prod.dim_calc_term term ON cs01.dim_calc_term_id = term.dim_calc_term_id
	and term.calc_dim_type = 'TERM'
	and cs01.business_date = term.business_date
	join radar_reporting_prod.dim_calc_curve curve ON cs01.dim_calc_curve_id = curve.dim_calc_curve_id
	and curve.calc_dim_type = 'CURVE'
	and cs01.business_date = curve.business_date
	join radar_reporting_prod.dim_calc_curve_type curve_type ON cs01.dim_calc_curve_type_id = curve_type.dim_calc_curve_type_id
	and curve_type.calc_dim_type = 'CURVE_TYPE'

	join radar_reporting_prod.dim_pos_inst dpi ON cs01.pos_id = dpi.pos_id

	left join radar_reporting_prod.dim_inst main_inst on main_inst.inst_id = dpi.inst_id
	left join radar_reporting_prod.dim_inst inst1 on inst1.inst_id = dpi.inst1_id

	left join risk_hierarchy rh on rh.dim_hierarchy_node_id = cs01.dim_hierarchy_node_id
	left join radar_reporting_prod.ref_legal_entity i_rle on i_rle.legal_entity_id = dpi.issuer_id
	left join radar_reporting_prod.ref_legal_entity cp_rle on cp_rle.legal_entity_id = dpi.counter_party_id

	left join radar_reporting_prod.cppib_party_rating cpr on cpr.cppib_party_id = i_rle.cppib_party_id

	left join radar_reporting_prod.cppib_security_rating csr on csr.cppib_sec_id = cast(dpi.cppib_security_id as int)
	and csr.business_date = i_rle.business_date
where cs01.calc_type = 'CS01'

--CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW real_assets_portfolio_listed AS
WITH 
quarter_end AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter',  CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1' DAY AS quarter_end_date
),
quarter_start AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '3' MONTH AS quarter_start_date
),
latest_fiscal_quarter AS (
    SELECT CONCAT(
             'F', 
             SUBSTR(CAST(YEAR(reporting_date) as VARCHAR), 3, 2), 
             ' Q', 
             CAST(QUARTER(reporting_date) as VARCHAR)
           ) AS reporting_period
      FROM (
            SELECT CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM quarter_end_date) BETWEEN 4 AND 12 
                        THEN DATE_ADD('month', -3, DATE_ADD('year', 1, quarter_end_date))
                        ELSE DATE_ADD('month', 9, quarter_end_date)
                   END AS reporting_date
              FROM quarter_end
           )
),
listed_real_estate_model_portfolios AS (
     SELECT CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)               AS business_date,
            mp.model_portfolio_id,
            mp.model_portfolio_name,
            mp.int_ext_managed_and_managed_accounts_name,
            CASE mp.regional_classification_name
                 WHEN 'Emerging Markets' 
                 THEN 'Emerging'
                 ELSE 'Developed'
            END                                           AS developed_or_emerging
       FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten pif
 INNER JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio mp
         ON pif.model_portfolio                    = mp.model_portfolio_id
      WHERE pif.model_portfolio_name        NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructure                = 'CPPIB_F24'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel2          = 'Real Assets'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel3          = 'Real Estate'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel4          = 'Listed Real Estate'
        AND CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)        = CAST(mp.business_date AS DATE)
),
listed_infrastrucure_model_portfolios AS (
     SELECT CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)               AS business_date,
            mp.model_portfolio_id,
            mp.model_portfolio_name,
            mp.int_ext_managed_and_managed_accounts_name,
            CASE mp.regional_classification_name
                 WHEN 'Emerging Markets' 
                 THEN 'Emerging'
                 ELSE 'Developed'
            END                                           AS developed_or_emerging
       FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten pif
 INNER JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio mp
         ON pif.model_portfolio                    = mp.model_portfolio_id
      WHERE pif.model_portfolio_name        NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructure                = 'CPPIB_F24'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel2          = 'Real Assets'
        AND (
              (     pif.InvestmentStructureLevel3          = 'Infrastructure'
                AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel4         IN ('Dev Mkts - Infrastructure', 'Emerging Mkts - Infrastructure')
                AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel5         IN ('Listed Infrastructure - DM', 'Listed Infrastructure - EM')
                AND pif.model_portfolio NOT IN ('')
              )
              OR pif.model_portfolio IN ('MIN1000104')
        )
        AND CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)        = CAST(mp.business_date AS DATE)
),
listed_sustainable_energies_model_portfolios AS (
     SELECT CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)               AS business_date,
            mp.model_portfolio_id,
            mp.model_portfolio_name,
            mp.int_ext_managed_and_managed_accounts_name,
            CASE mp.regional_classification_name
                 WHEN 'Emerging Markets' 
                 THEN 'Emerging'
                 ELSE 'Developed'
            END                                           AS developed_or_emerging
       FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten pif
 INNER JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio mp
         ON pif.model_portfolio                    = mp.model_portfolio_id
      WHERE pif.model_portfolio_name      NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructure                = 'CPPIB_F24'    
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel2          = 'Real Assets'
        AND (
              (     pif.InvestmentStructureLevel3     = 'Sustainable Energy Group'
                AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel4     IN ('Power and Renewables Group')
                AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel5     IN ('Power Generation')
                AND pif.investmentstructurelevel6     IN ('DM - Power Generation', 'EM - Power Generation')
                AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel7     IN ('Listed DM', 'Listed EM')
                AND pif.model_portfolio           NOT IN ('')
              )
              OR pif.model_portfolio IN ('MPRSBE0', 'MPR1000279', 'MPR1000328', 'MPR1000200', 'MPAR100041')
        )
        AND CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)        = CAST(mp.business_date AS DATE)
),
listed_real_assets_model_portfolios AS (
     SELECT * 
       FROM listed_infrastrucure_model_portfolios
  UNION ALL
     SELECT * 
       FROM listed_real_estate_model_portfolios
  UNION ALL
     SELECT * 
       FROM listed_sustainable_energies_model_portfolios
),
latest_abor_transactions AS (
     SELECT t.abor_transaction_number,
            MAX(t.business_date)       AS business_date
       FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions t
      WHERE t.transaction_cancellation_flag  = 'Active'
        AND t.business_transaction_code     != 'BalBook' -- come back to this
   GROUP BY t.abor_transaction_number
),
latest_transactions AS (
     SELECT t.elementary_transaction_code,
            t.payment_amount_portfolio_currency,
            t.current_value_portfolio_currency,
            t.period_closure_date,
            t.abor_security_id
       FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions t
 INNER JOIN listed_real_assets_model_portfolios mp
         ON t.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio_id
 INNER JOIN latest_abor_transactions lat
         ON t.abor_transaction_number = lat.abor_transaction_number
        AND t.business_date           = lat.business_date
      WHERE t.transaction_cancellation_flag     = 'Active'
        AND t.business_transaction_code        != 'BalBook'
        AND CAST(t.period_closure_date AS DATE) <= (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
        AND CAST(t.period_closure_date AS DATE) >= (SELECT quarter_start_date FROM quarter_start)
),
latest_total_buys_and_sells AS(
     SELECT abor_security_id,
            SUM(
              CASE WHEN elementary_transaction_code IN ('CABuy', 'BuyInternal', 'Buy') 
                   THEN payment_amount_portfolio_currency 
                   ELSE 0 
              END
            ) AS total_buy_portfolio_currency_cad, -- changed from just buy to 'CABuy', 'BuyInternal', 'Buy'
            SUM(
              CASE WHEN elementary_transaction_code IN ('CASell', 'SellInternal', 'Sell')
                   THEN current_value_portfolio_currency 
                   ELSE 0 
              END
            ) AS total_sell_portfolio_currency_cad  -- changed from just sell to ('CASell', 'SellInternal', 'Sell')
       FROM latest_transactions
   GROUP BY abor_security_id
),
latest_holdings AS (
     SELECT CAST(h.business_date AS DATE)               AS business_date,
            int_ext_managed_and_managed_accounts_name,
            asec.cppib_sector_classification_name_3,
            asec.cppib_sector_classification_name_4,
            s.country_of_exposure_name,
            developed_or_emerging,
            h.abor_security_id,
            abor_security_name,
            model_portfolio_name,
            abor_country_of_exposure_name,
            balance_cost_value_portfolio_currency,
            dirty_value_total_portfolio_currency,
            exposure_portfolio_currency,
            tbs.total_buy_portfolio_currency_cad        AS gross_invested_equity_historical,
            tbs.total_sell_portfolio_currency_cad       AS permanent_roc_historical,
            quotation_currency_code
       FROM holdings.scd_holdings_main h
 INNER JOIN listed_real_assets_model_portfolios mp
         ON h.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio_id
        AND CAST(h.business_date AS DATE)                        = CAST(mp.business_date AS DATE)
 INNER JOIN reference.scd_securities s
         ON h.abor_security_id                                   = s.abor_security_id
        AND CAST(h.business_date AS DATE)                        = CAST(s.business_date AS DATE)
  FULL JOIN latest_total_buys_and_sells tbs
         ON h.abor_security_id                                   = tbs.abor_security_id
  LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications asec
         ON h.cppib_sec_id                                       = CAST(asec.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR)
        AND CAST(h.business_date AS DATE)                        = CAST(asec.business_date AS DATE)
      WHERE CAST(h.business_date AS DATE)                        = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
        AND asec.cppib_sector_classification_name_4       NOT LIKE '%Discontinued%'
),
ra_deals AS (
     SELECT (SELECT reporting_period FROM latest_fiscal_quarter)          AS reporting_period,
            business_date                                                 AS business_date,
            CAST(NULL AS DATE)                                            AS as_of_date,
            abor_security_id                                              AS investment_code,
            abor_security_name                                            AS investment_name,
            abor_security_name                                            AS investment_aggregate_name,
            abor_security_name                                            AS reporting_name,
            abor_security_name                                            AS allocation_name,
            abor_security_name                                            AS model_portfolio_name,
            CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(32, 2))                                  AS cppib_ownership_percentage,
            'Other'                                                       AS investment_structure,
            CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR)                                         AS investment_stage,
            country_of_exposure_name                                      AS geographic_focus,
            cppib_sector_classification_name_3                            AS sector_focus,
            cppib_sector_classification_name_4                            AS sub_sector_focus,
            'Real Assets'                                                 AS investment_department,
            'Real Estate'                                                 AS investment_group,
            'Listed Real Estate'                                          AS business_unit,
            quotation_currency_code                                       AS local_reporting_currency,
            CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR)                                         AS investment_count,
            developed_or_emerging                                         AS developed_emerging_country,
            int_ext_managed_and_managed_accounts_name                     AS investment_manager,
            CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(32, 2))                                  AS allocation,
            CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(32, 2))                                  AS commitments,
            CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(32, 8))                                  AS uncommitted_allocation,
            CAST(gross_invested_equity_historical AS DECIMAL(32, 2))      AS gross_invested_equity,
            CAST(gross_invested_equity_historical AS DECIMAL(32, 2))      AS gross_invested_equity_historical,

/* cppi::950f7685ce95e3a252a9cc36b8e7a4be4114802cbfd91709d87c0eec6e43454f */
with 
	TOTAL_PV as
	  (
	    select fact.analytic_value as pv
	    from radar_reporting_prod.FACT_ANALYTIC_SD fact
	    join radar_reporting_prod.dim_chron c on fact.chron_id = c.chron_id
	    join radar_reporting_prod.DIM_HIERARCHY_NODE node on fact.DIM_HIERARCHY_NODE_ID = node.DIM_HIERARCHY_NODE_ID and fact.chron_id = node.chron_id
	    where
		  c.business_date = '2025-06-04'
	      AND fact.ANALYTIC_TYPE = 'PV'
	      AND fact.PORTFOLIO_TYPE = 'IP'
	      AND node.node_level = 1
		  AND node.hierarchy_type = 'RISK'
		  and c.canonical_source = '1'
	  ),
	category_limits as
	  (
	    select 'FI' as category, pv * 0.3 as limit from TOTAL_PV
	    union all
	    select 'BBB' as category, pv * 0.0625 as limit from TOTAL_PV
	    union all
	    select 'BB' as category, pv * 0.0525 as limit from TOTAL_PV
	    union all
	    select '<= B' as category, pv * 0.0425 as limit from TOTAL_PV
	  ),
	WF_VW_CREDIT_EXPOSURE_MINI as
	  (
	    select
          parent.party_name,
          sum( case when credit_exposure is not null and parent.gics_sector = 'Financials' then credit_exposure else 0 end) as fi_ce,
          sum( case when credit_exposure is not null and regexp_like( parent.rtg_final, '^BBB[\+\-]?$' ) then credit_exposure else 0 end) as bbb_ce,
          sum( case when credit_exposure is not null and regexp_like( parent.rtg_final, '^BB[\+\-]?$' ) then credit_exposure else 0 end) as bb_ce,
          sum( case when credit_exposure is not null and regexp_like( parent.rtg_final, '(^B[\+\-]?$|C|D)' ) then credit_exposure else 0 end) as b_or_below_ce
        from
		  radar_reporting_prod.fact_cr_exposure fact,
          radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity child,
		  radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity parent
        where fact.business_date = '2025-06-04'
          and fact.business_date = child.business_date
          and fact.business_date = parent.business_date
          AND fact.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
		  AND child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
          AND NOT ( (parent.is_government = 'Y' OR parent.is_provincial = 'Y' ) AND parent.domicile_country_code in ('US', 'CA') )
        group by parent.party_name
	  ),
	  summary_ce as 
	  (
	  select *
	    from
	      (
	        select
	          v.*,
	           sum(fi_ce) over () as sum_fi_ce,
               sum(bbb_ce) over () as sum_bbb_ce,
               sum(bb_ce) over () as sum_bb_ce,
               sum(b_or_below_ce) over () as sum_b_or_below_ce,
               row_number() over ( order by fi_ce desc ) as fi_ce_rank,
               row_number() over ( order by bbb_ce desc ) as bbb_ce_rank,
               row_number() over ( order by bb_ce desc ) as bb_ce_rank,
               row_number() over ( order by b_or_below_ce desc ) as b_or_below_ce_rank
	        from WF_VW_CREDIT_EXPOSURE_MINI v
	      )
	      CROSS JOIN UNNEST(
	        array['FI', 'BBB', 'BB', '<=B'], array[fi_ce, bbb_ce, bb_ce, b_or_below_ce], array[sum_fi_ce, sum_bbb_ce, sum_bb_ce, sum_b_or_below_ce], array[fi_ce_rank, bbb_ce_rank, bb_ce_rank, b_or_below_ce_rank]
	      ) as t(category, top_exposure, total_exposure, rank)
	     where rank = 1
	     )
	     select
	  ce.category,
	  total_exposure / 1000000 AS total_exposure,
	  limit / 1000000 AS limit,
	  ROUND( total_exposure / limit * 100, 1) AS limit_util,
	  case
	    WHEN limit IS NULL OR limit >= total_exposure THEN 'OK'
	    ELSE 'BREACH'
	  END AS status,
	  party_name AS top_issuer_name,
	  top_exposure / 1000000 AS top_exposure
	FROM summary_ce ce, category_limits cl
	WHERE ce.category = cl.category and limit IS NOT NULL AND limit < total_exposure
	order by case WHEN ce.category = 'FI' THEN 1 WHEN ce.category = 'BBB' THEN 2 WHEN ce.category = 'BB' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END

                             WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.product_type_category = 'PRIME BROKERAGE' AND UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type) THEN fact.credit_exposure
                             ELSE 0
                             END
                     ) AS pb_exp,
                 SUM(
                         CASE
                             WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type) THEN fact.credit_exposure
                             ELSE 0
                             END
                     ) AS other_exp,

                 SUM(
                         CASE
                             WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                                  (
                                          EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.product_type_category IN ('CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE') AND UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type)
                                          OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type)
                                      )
                                 THEN fact.credit_exposure
                             ELSE 0
                             END
                     ) AS total_cash_pb_exp,
                 MAX(child.total_cash_pb_smd_fi_limit) AS total_cash_pb_smd_limit,

                 SUM(
                         CASE
                             WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.product_type_category = 'REPOS' AND UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type) THEN fact.credit_exposure
                             ELSE 0
                             END
                     ) AS repo_sbl_exp,
                 MAX(child.repo_fi_limit) AS repo_sbl_smd_threshold,

                 SUM(
                         CASE
                             WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.product_type_category = 'DERIVATIVES' AND UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type) THEN fact.credit_exposure
                             ELSE 0
                             END
                     ) AS der_exp,
                 MAX(child.der_fi_limit) AS der_smd_threshold,

                 SUM(
                         CASE
                             WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.product_type_category IN ('DERIVATIVES', 'REPOS') AND UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type) THEN fact.credit_exposure
                             ELSE 0
                             END
                     ) AS total_der_repo_sbl_exp,
                 MAX(child.der_repo_fi_limit) AS total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit,
                 SUM(
                         CASE
                             WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                                  (
                                          EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.product_type_category IN ('CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE') AND UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type)
                                          OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type)
                                      )
                                 OR
                                  (
                                      EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.product_type_category IN ('DERIVATIVES', 'REPOS') AND UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type)
                                      )
                                 THEN fact.credit_exposure
                             ELSE 0
                             END
                     ) AS isrc_total_exp,
                 MAX(child.isrc_total_fi_limit) AS isrc_total_limit,
                 SUM(
                         CASE
                             WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                                  (
                                          EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.product_type_category IN ('CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE') AND UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type)
                                          OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type)
                                      )
                                 OR
                                  (
                                      EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.product_type_category IN ('DERIVATIVES', 'REPOS') AND UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type)
                                      )
                                 THEN fact.credit_exposure
                             ELSE 0
                             END
                     ) AS smd_total_exp,
                 MAX(child.smd_total_fi_limit) AS smd_total_limit,
                 SUM(COALESCE(fact.credit_exposure, 0)) AS total_exp
             FROM
                 radar_reporting_prod.fact_cr_exposure fact,
                 radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity child,
                 radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst pos,
                 radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity parent
                 left join radar_reporting_prod.ref_country country on country.business_date = parent.business_date and parent.domicile_country_code = country.alpha_2_code
             WHERE
                 fact.business_date = '2025-06-04'
                 and fact.business_date = child.business_date
                 and fact.business_date = pos.business_date
                 and fact.business_date = parent.business_date
                 AND fact.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
                 AND child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
                 AND fact.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id = pos.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id
                 AND UPPER(pos.product_type) <> 'NETTING'
                 AND
                 (
                         parent.is_fi = 'Y'
                         OR child.is_fi = 'Y'
                         OR EXISTS
                                 (
                                     SELECT 1
                                     FROM radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity sibling
                                     WHERE
                                       parent.business_date = sibling.business_date 
									   and sibling.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
                                       AND sibling.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id <> child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
                                       AND sibling.is_fi = 'Y'
                                 )
                     )
             GROUP BY
                 parent.party_name,
                 parent.cppib_party_id,
                 parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
                 COALESCE(country.name, parent.domicile_country_code),
                 parent.rtg_final,
                 parent.rtg_outlook
         ),
     prev_exp_total AS
         (
             SELECT
                 parent.party_name,
                 parent.cppib_party_id,
                 parent.rtg_final AS prev_rtg_final,
                 SUM(
